resolution.question: Will Veldt Solar's executive team formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot at its quarterly review, and communicate the call to the pilot team the same week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally communicated a decision (either shelve or greenlight) to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
